title: Material design
summary: Google's 2014 reel introducing Material Design, a visual language based on a paper-and-ink material metaphor and a system of motion. It is a short promotional video.
why: HN mentions it as the polished design-team vision that Android's actual implementation fell short of.

quote.text: the rendered demo videos (e.g. ) from the Design team are amazing, but what's actually been implemented on Android is far less sophisticated
